raw_segments.text: Polonius. This business is well-ended. My Legion, madam, to expostulate what majesty
should be, what duty is, why day is day, night-night, and time is time where nothing but to waste
night, day and time. Therefore, since brevity is the soul of wit, and tediousness the limbs
and outward flourishes, I will be brief. Your noble son is mad. Mad call I it, for to define
true madness, what ist but to be nothing else but mad. But let that go.
